about: A hung application, visible and ended in one keystroke (docs/adr/0067-hangs-and-force-quit.mdx), as on a Mac. Hang Probe (sample/HangProbe.tsx), installed and opened from the dock, runs its JavaScript thread for 30 s when its button is pressed, so it reads no event and answers no Ping. The pointer moving over it pings it; 2 s unanswered, the compositor shows its own wait cursor there; 5 s, it is not responding. Super+Alt+Escape (⌥⌘⎋): Force Quit Applications lists it, Not Responding, chosen, the keyboard on Force Quit; Return ends it after its hang's report (SIGQUIT: the host writes its JavaScript thread's stack), which the crash reports keep, saying the hang; no "quit unexpectedly" is said. With the compositor not showing the wait cursor, or the shortcut reaching the application, or the report missing, the run fails. At 1 (1280 × 720).

steps.name: Hang Probe from the dock: its window, its buttons
its button: it takes the press, then hangs
the pointer moves over it: pinged, and not answered yet the application's cursor still
2 s unanswered: the compositor's wait cursor over it, whatever it asked for
5 s unanswered: not responding (the dock's menu and Force Quit say so)
Super+Alt+Escape: Force Quit Applications, Hang Probe Not Responding and chosen, the keyboard on Force Quit; the key reaches no application

texts: If an app doesn't respond for a while, select its name and click Force Quit.

steps.name: Return: Force Quit; its hang's report first, then it ends
its report says the hang and what its JavaScript thread was doing; nothing says it quit unexpectedly

contains: Hang Probe stopped responding and was force quit.
